entries.heading: MODIFICATION OF MINOR CONSTRUCTION THRESHOLD FOR PLANT PROJECTS
ancestors: DIVISION C—DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY NATIONAL SECURITY AUTHORIZATIONS AND OTHER AUTHORIZATIONS
TITLE XXXI—DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY NATIONAL SECURITY PROGRAMS
Subtitle B—Program Authorizations, Restrictions, and Limitations
entries.text:
SEC. 3119. MODIFICATION OF MINOR CONSTRUCTION THRESHOLD FOR PLANT 
                          PROJECTS.

    Section 4701(2) of the Atomic Energy Defense Act (50 U.S.C. 2741(2)) 
is amended by striking ``$10,000,000'' and inserting ``$20,000,000''.
